vo.text: Stop trivial adjustments reaching Lynx. Set the percentage below which a suggestion is either zeroed or lifted to the threshold value.
vo.next_text: The gear button at the right of the toolbar, in its right-hand button group, opens the settings dialog.

vo.text: The gear button at the right of the toolbar, in its right-hand button group, opens the settings dialog.
vo.previous_text: Stop trivial adjustments reaching Lynx. Set the percentage below which a suggestion is either zeroed or lifted to the threshold value.
vo.next_text: It opens on Calculation, unless you have used Review Threshold in the Push Changes dialog since the page loaded, in which case it opens on Minimum Threshold.

vo.text: It opens on Calculation, unless you have used Review Threshold in the Push Changes dialog since the page loaded, in which case it opens on Minimum Threshold.

vo.text: The Settings dialog is now on the Minimum Threshold tab.
vo.previous_text: The left rail lists the settings groups. Minimum Threshold sits second, under Calculation.
vo.next_text: Type the cutoff as a whole number between 0 and 50. Setting the percentage to 0 disables the feature entirely.

vo.text: Type the cutoff as a whole number between 0 and 50. Setting the percentage to 0 disables the feature entirely.
vo.previous_text: The Settings dialog is now on the Minimum Threshold tab.
vo.next_text: Here the threshold is set to 10 percent. The 0 to 50 bound is enforced by the dialog only. There is no server-side check.

vo.text: Here the threshold is set to 10 percent. The 0 to 50 bound is enforced by the dialog only. There is no server-side check.
vo.previous_text: Type the cutoff as a whole number between 0 and 50. Setting the percentage to 0 disables the feature entirely.
vo.next_text: Set to zero means Lynx receives 0 percent. Set to the minimum threshold value raises the suggestion up to the threshold instead, so the station still gets a small run.

vo.text: Set to zero means Lynx receives 0 percent. Set to the minimum threshold value raises the suggestion up to the threshold instead, so the station still gets a small run.
vo.previous_text: Here the threshold is set to 10 percent. The 0 to 50 bound is enforced by the dialog only. There is no server-side check.
vo.next_text: Exclude Zeros, available only on the second option, leaves genuine zeros at zero rather than lifting them.

vo.text: Exclude Zeros, available only on the second option, leaves genuine zeros at zero rather than lifting them.
vo.previous_text: Set to zero means Lynx receives 0 percent. Set to the minimum threshold value raises the suggestion up to the threshold instead, so the station still gets a small run.
vo.next_text: Save Changes saves the edits on every tab of Settings together. A threshold-only change does not reload the dashboard; the pending push list is simply recalculated.

vo.next_text: Open Push Changes and the pink banner tells you how many stations the threshold touched, with each affected row showing its original value and the adjusted one.
